translations.web: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.
translations.bsb: So they read from the Book of the Law of God, explaining it and giving insight, so that the people could understand what was being read.
translations.kjv: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
translations.asv: And they read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.
